chapter_seo_title: Dao Gui Yi Xian Chapter 439: Li Huowang Faces Identity Erasure by the Doumu
chapter_meta_description: Trapped beneath the gaze of a Siming, Li Huowang's memories are overwritten. Can Zhuge Yuan's sacrifice buy him enough time to remember who he is?
og_title: The Siming Rewrites Li Huowang's Past
og_description: Li Huowang’s face is stolen, his memories are fake—Zhuge Yuan’s last stand is the only thing holding his identity together.
twitter_title: Zuowandao Chapter: Identity Heist by a God
twitter_description: The Doumu is rewriting Li Huowang's entire life story in real time. Zhuge Yuan makes a desperate play.

lore_anchors.definition: The Mother of the Big Dipper, a high Daoist deity. In this novel, she is a Siming whose form is an infinite yin-yang ocean; direct observation causes the observer’s identity to unravel.
The Way of Sitting in Forgetfulness. A secret society of liars and tricksters dedicated to spreading confusion and chaos for their own amusement.
A rare human constitution in the Dao-Twisted World that makes the bearer valuable as a living alchemical ingredient.
A scholar’s writing brush used by Zhuge Yuan as a weapon; in this novel, it is used to write cosmic laws and taboos into existence.
A key hierarchical concept: high gods can only project a limited “manifestation” into lower realms without causing reality collapse.
A heretical scripture of the Zuowandao used to summon manifestations of high Siming like Doumu.
